description:
Advances: specled.package

From specled_-zhe cold verification (2026-07-25): specled.package.adoption_guide and specled.package.concepts_guide are must requirements verified by kind: source_file, which verifier.ex satisfies with file existence plus a substring match on the covers marker. Every content clause the requirement statements name (greenfield+brownfield paths, severity-graduation step, Phase 4a/4b split, verdict read protocol in adoption.md; triangle, realized_by tiers, graceful degrade, drift acceptance paths, verdict protocol in concepts.md) could be deleted with spec.check staying green — which is how the N4-N11 doc rot went undetected. Fix needs a content-lint test asserting the clauses exist plus a spec-verification change in .spec/specs/package.spec.md (tagged_tests or command kind replacing/augmenting the source_file stubs). All clauses verified present as of specled_-zhe commit.
title: Content-lint verification for adoption_guide/concepts_guide must requirements (source_file is existence-only)
